instruction:
GUI-only requirement: Complete the entire task through the launched graphical user interfaces only. Do not open Terminal, Command Prompt, PowerShell, or any shell. Do not run Python, VBA, macros, Abaqus noGUI, ANSYS command scripts, batch/headless tools, APIs, or helper code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only the native SolidWorks and Abaqus/CAE GUI tools, menus, dialogs, editors, and built-in import, export, save, submit, and solve commands.

Two-software CAE flow: SolidWorks -> Abaqus/CAE. No init file is provided; start from a new blank SolidWorks part.

Chain evidence requirement: use the design token EW_SW_ABQ_06. Keep this token encoded in the SolidWorks part/custom properties or STEP export metadata so the text of stage1_geometry.step contains EW_SW_ABQ_06 and SOLIDWORKS_TO_ABAQUS. In Abaqus/CAE, create at least one model, part, instance, set, surface, job description, or other native name containing both EW_SW_ABQ_06 and IMPORTED_FROM_stage1_geometry.step, so the final CAE file carries evidence that Abaqus consumed the SolidWorks STEP handoff.


1. In SolidWorks, use GUI sketch and feature tools only to create a clevis-style pin bracket with a 90 mm x 40 mm x 8 mm base, two upright lugs about 38 mm high, two D6 base mounting holes, and a D16 through pin bore across the lugs. Export the completed CAD geometry to C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step.
2. In Abaqus/CAE, import stage1_geometry.step through the GUI and create the finite-element model. Use the model name Model-ClevisPinLoad. Define material Steel with E=210000 MPa and nu=0.3, create a solid section using Steel, and assign it to the bracket. Create a Static General analysis step named Step-PinLoad. Create sets named BASE_HOLES and PIN_BORE, plus a surface named PIN_BORE_SURFACE. Use a coarse first-order linear solid mesh without quadratic elements. Create a boundary condition named BC-BaseHoles that constrains BASE_HOLES. Create a load named Load-Pin1500N that applies an approximately -1500 N vertical or bearing load on PIN_BORE_SURFACE. Submit the job named Job-ClevisPinLoad and wait for the analysis to complete.
3. Required deliverables on the Desktop: C:\Users\user\Desktop\stage1_geometry.step, C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-ClevisPinLoad.cae, and C:\Users\user\Desktop\Job-ClevisPinLoad.odb. Do not create extra STEP, DXF, CAE, or ODB deliverables.

[Software] Open and use SolidWorks and Abaqus/CAE one at a time through the Windows GUI as needed. First use SolidWorks to create and export the CAD STEP file, then use Abaqus/CAE to import that STEP file, build the finite-element model, submit the job, and save the CAE and ODB deliverables.
notes: Controlled-diversity GUI chained CAE task with post-hoc chain evidence checks.
